#### Oncology

Compassionate Care in the Fight Against Cancer

Cancer can affect pets at any stage of life, presenting in many forms and often progressing silently before symptoms appear. Early detection and timely intervention can make a meaningful difference in treatment success and quality of life.

Our Oncology service provides comprehensive evaluation and management of cancer through advanced diagnostics and individualised treatment plans. We work closely with pet families throughout the journey, offering guidance and support at every step of care.

The department is powered by The Cancer Vet, India’s first designated veterinary oncology practice, and is led and supervised by Dr. Noopur Desai - an American-trained and board-certified oncologist,DACVR (R. Oncology).

#### Our Oncology Services Include

Oncology consultations and second opinions

Oncology consultations and second opinions

Chemotherapy and medical oncology

Radiation therapy, planned and supervised by a board-certified veterinarian and oncologist
Noopur Desai worked as an Assistant Professor of Oncology at TheOhio State University. One of the main reasons she moved back to India was to bring home what she learned over the years in the US and enhance cancer care for pets in India. Her passion lies in treating patients, training the next generation of veterinarians, and conducting clinical research. The department of Oncology brings together specialist oncologists and surgeons under the supervision of a Diplomate of the American College of Veterinary Medicine in Radiation Oncology. The team covers cancer diagnosis and staging, chemotherapy and medical oncology, surgical oncology, and supportive and palliative care.

Image: Dr. Namaeta Nadkarni

## Dr. Namaeta Nadkarni

#### BVS, MS, U.S., (Radiation & Advanced Surgery)

Dr. Namaeta Nadkarni is a veterinary surgeon with a Master's degree in Surgery from Mumbai Veterinary College and extensive clinical experience in small-animal surgical surgeries and surgeries. She has further advanced her surgical expertise in performing surgeries for many institutions, including Colorado State University and Texas State University, with a focus on minimally invasive surgery and endoscopy. With eight years of experience in private practice in Mumbai, Dr. Nadkarni has developed significant expertise in complex surgical procedures, such as thyroidectomy, thyroidectomy, thyroidotomy, and colectomy. He is also experienced in surgical surgical technical techniques, with a focus on delivering precise, specialised management of cancer and minimally invasive surgical technologies, with a focus on delivering precise, specialised management of small-animal patients.

Image: Dr. Shveya Pandey

## Dr. Shreya Pandey

#### BVS & A.A.

Dr. Shreya Pandey is a veterinary specialist with a strong focus on cancer diagnosis and management in companion animals. A graduate of Medical Veterinary College, she brings hands-on clinical experience across physical treatments, medical diagnostics, and patient training. Her clinical practice focuses on veterinary oncology and comprehensive cancer care, with an emphasis on accurate diagnosis, treatment planning and helping pet parents understand the available options for managing cancer in their pets. Dr. Shreya is committed to advancing access to specialised oncology care for companion animals and to providing evidence-based, compassionate treatment throughout the cancer care journey.

Image: Dr. Mukta Kubde

## Dr. Mukta Kubde

#### M.V.Sc.

Dr. Mukta Kubde is a veterinary professional with a Master's degree from Mumbai Veterinary College and substantial clinical experience in small-animal practice. Her clinical expertise encompasses small-animal medicine and veterinary oncology, with a focus on comprehensive cancer care and patient-centred treatment. She brings a strong foundation in clinical case management, combining sound scientific judgment with clinical precision. The compassionate person comes from various aspects focused on developing individualised treatment approaches and supporting pets and their families throughout the cancer care process.

Image: Dr. Shubhangi Yelmule

## Dr. Shubhangi Yelmule

#### M.V.Sc.

Dr. Shubhangi Yelmule holds a Bachelor's degree from Nagpur Veterinary College and a Master's degree in Radiation Biology from Goa, Akola. She brings clinical expertise in veterinary oncology and soft tissue surgery, while also training in 24 hours per day under a 24/7 schedule. Her practice combines surgical precision, clinical judgement and comprehensive patient care, with an emphasis on delivering advanced treatment while maintaining the comfort and quality of life of companion animals throughout their care.

### Appointment Hours

  * Medical Oncology: Tuesday – Friday, 8 am – 4:30 pm

## Individualized Cancer Care for Every Patient

Cancer can affect animals in many of the same ways it affects people. Angell’s Oncology service provides advanced, compassionate, and individualized cancer care for every patient.

Our team includes specialists in medical oncology, radiation oncology, and surgical oncology who work together within our state-of-the-art facility to deliver a truly integrated approach to treatment. Each patient’s care plan is thoughtfully developed based on their specific diagnosis, overall health, and the goals of their family, ensuring a tailored and comprehensive strategy.

Collaboration is central to how we care for our patients. Our Oncology team works closely with experts across the hospital — including Diagnostic Imaging, Pathology, Internal Medicine, Neurology, Ophthalmology, and Cardiology — to address the full scope of each patient’s needs. 
  * Biopsies and staging of neoplasms
  * Bloodwork
  * Bone marrow aspirations
  * Computed Tomography (CT)
  * Digital radiography and fluoroscopy
  * Ultrasonography
  * Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI)

### Medical Oncology Services

In our USP 800-compliant cancer clinic, our veterinary oncologists and nurses safely administer:

  * Chemotherapy
  * Immunotherapy/targeted therapies

### Radiation Therapy Services

Our radiation therapy unit houses a cutting-edge True Beam Linear Accelerator. With the help of certified radiation therapists and specialty-trained anesthesia nurses, our team can safely and comfortably apply:

  * Intensity-modulated radiation therapy (IMRT)
  * Volumetric modulated Arc Therapy (VMAT)
  * Stereotactic radiation treatment

### Surgical Oncology Services

Angell Animal Medical Center is the only veterinary hospital in Boston — and one of the few located throughout New England — to have a surgical oncologist on staff. Our team includes Dr. Megan Cray, a board-certified surgeon with fellowship training in surgical oncology. She works with our medical and radiation oncology specialists to provide integrated care for each patient, offering surgical management of many tumor types, including, but not limited to:

  * Bone tumors
  * Bladder tumors
  * Skin and subcutaneous masses
  * Lung tumors
  * Anal sac gland tumors
  * Lymph node removal
  * Liver tumors
  * Splenic masses
  * Adrenal masses
  * Kidney tumors      
  * Gastrointestinal tumors
  * Oral cancer
  * Body/chest wall masses
  * Head and neck cancer (including thyroid/parathyroid masses)
